title: Podman podman-compose integration for Compose runtime target

evidence.description: Added PodmanComposeRuntime that wraps ComposeRuntime with Podman socket and auto-detected podman compose binary. Wired into factory when runtime_type=podman with compose_dir set.
implementation: PodmanComposeRuntime type wrapping ComposeRuntime with Podman Type()
detectPodmanComposeBinary() checks: podman compose > docker compose > podman-compose > docker-compose
Factory creates PodmanComposeRuntime when type=podman + compose_dir is set + execution_mode=cli
PodmanObserver Engine API path unchanged for non-Compose Podman usage
compatibility_findings: Podman 3+ supports docker compose subcommand via podman-docker compatibility
podman-compose is a separate Python tool with reduced feature coverage
Compose operations work against Podman socket when DOCKER_HOST points to it
PodmanObserver.ApplyDesiredState still rejects compose_extension for Engine API path
